SafeLoc multi-project research engine validation

October 2–3, 2026. Run timestamps are UTC. Three approved initial arbitrary projects, two approved routing confirmations, and three subsequently approved identity-repair confirmations. Live providers through the development workbench’s normal production engine path; not a published-deployment test.

ENGINE IMPROVED BUT STILL HAS A SYSTEMIC BOTTLENECK

Two reproduced conversion defects were repaired without lowering evidence standards or increasing budgets: exact-project unlabeled passage routing, and an identity follow-up query exception after a successful provider response. The latter no longer occurs in any of the three final runs. Provider-failure completeness reporting was also corrected. Nevertheless all eight captures have zero eligible findings. Final IREN/Vantage retained eight usable source passages but sent zero passage text into assessment; AWS sent two distinct packet texts. Public scope ambiguity, blocked sources and technical incompleteness prevent a claim of reliable arbitrary-project conversion or genuine public-evidence insufficiency.

Single highest-value next product action: use provider-free production-path fixtures to make retained related-campus/phase text available to identity disambiguation, without promoting ambiguous context into exact-project evidence or eligible claims. Prioritize the captured IREN/Vantage zero-passage assessment boundary before any further paid confirmation.

7. Ranked conversion losses, fixes and regressions

  1. Retained campus/phase context does not reliably reach identity-disambiguating assessment. Final IREN/Vantage retain four sources each but issue zero passage text in their packets. Related Sweetwater sites and AZ1/AZ2 must remain distinct; ambiguity is not eligibility. However retained relevant context lost before analysis is a conversion boundary, not proof that public evidence is absent. AWS issues two packet texts but seven generated records lack a mapped supporting passage. Exact root cause of every generic unmapped record is unavailable, not assigned by guess.
  2. Bounded admission/deadline and access losses leave technical coverage incomplete. Final source-open non-retention is 4/10 AWS, 8/12 IREN and 7/11 Vantage. AWS TPM/deadline skips four categories; IREN/Vantage each have two deadline cancellations before issue. Operator/municipal blocks cannot support a negative finding. No budget inflation or provider/architecture change was used to hide this loss.
  3. Internal routing/query/status defects — reproduced and repaired. Unlabeled exact-project retained text was erased at routing: the failing packet fixture drove a gated generalized fix, preserving generic-index/mixed-label negatives. Then a provider-free production fixture captured TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0') after identity HTTP 200. Planned categories expose categoryId while the query builder read id and mistakenly requested financial-variable queries for identity. Normalizing the identifier repairs it across TX/GA/AZ fixtures. An empty financial-slot inventory also falsely marked failed identity assessment Complete; explicit failure now takes precedence. Original exception name/message/stage is bounded and sanitized, with no stack/credential leakage.

Live confirmation: identity primary analysis completed in all three final projects; no TypeError/upstream identity failure recurred. AWS identity is Complete, IREN/Vantage Partial with insufficient exact context. The only final captured exceptions are four deadline cancellations. Offline provider-500 and 429 negatives remain covered; successful acquisition is distinct from completed analysis. Observed discovery with zero candidates now reaches a legitimate no-eligible result rather than crashing. Identity may use its existing one bounded follow-up; no retry limit was increased. Original 21 initial and 23 routing-confirmation capture hashes rechecked intact.

No backend, login or network request is needed. The preserved five-run provisional report is superseded by this report, not overwritten.
